character.name: Young Argentine conscript soldier, 1982 Falklands War. Olive-drab green wool army uniform under a heavy field parka, dark green knitted scarf around the neck, mud-caked black combat boots. US-style M1 steel helmet, olive green, slightly dented, chin strap. Gaunt tired young face, cold-reddened cheeks, faint stubble, hollow eyes. Worn dirty mud-stained webbing gear,  Muted desaturated earthy palette, painterly pixel art with dense dithered shading, grim survival-horror tone like Fear & Hunger and Darkest Dungeon, low top-down view.
